fileLogLevel_comment: Writes stryker.log next to this file, so a failed run can be diagnosed from disk.
incremental_comment: Reruns only retest mutants whose code or covering tests changed. Delete the file (or pass --force) for a clean full run. CI starts without the file, so CI always runs in full.
mutate_comment: Excluded: the entry barrel (index.ts) and type-only declarations (types.ts). Everything else under src is mutated.
thresholds_comment: Any survivor fails the run: the floor is 100% (timed-out mutants count as detected). Never lower `break`.
